notes.title: New UPDATE 1.1.2
notes.content:
Here is the complete patchnote for this update : 
[olist]
 Optimization of the HUD so that it is already on the screen when loading a map.
 Made scene transitions more seamless.
 Added red X on Moon Map and Phantom Map when a chest is obtained or a phantom is slayed.
 Added a new NPC in the clock tower which give the Omega Stone.
 Added a new NPC that reference the Parachnid Detector.
 Changed camera for them to stay at the same place when changing most maps.
 Redesigned the esthetics of the saving mechanism.
 Added a new model when planting seeds in the garden.
 Added an approximative timer above growing seeds in the garden.
 Added a dialog and a choice to the legendary sword that tell you that you risk losing your life if not enough HP.
 Got ride of unnecessary duplicate events on maps.
 Changed the teleportation crystal animations colors.
 Added a pole model on top of where the grappling hook tiles are.
 Changed the direction the character is looking at when coming back down from a grappling hook area.
 Fixed the stuck Gardening Shop and Lottery Stand floating text when night falls.
 Removed an unobtainable Yellow Flower by the church.
 Added the necklace bell sound effect where the first cat in the chest is located.
 Made that the animation when examining the Main Sarook Field direction pole play only one time.
 Fixed the camera inside Edrian House so it can be moved.
 Buffed the Mage Robe and the Moon Helmet.
 Cut scene correction.
 Text changes and correction.
 Minor Bug fixes.
 Other small tweaks.
 Stability enhancement.
[/olist]
We really hope that these changes and addition will help you enjoy the game even more!

notes.title: Adventure Field™ 12th anniversary limited physical edition!
notes.content:
To celebrate Adventure Field™ 12th anniversary, we're selling a very limited run of Adventure Field™ 4 physical edition that come with the Omega Stone and Adventure Field™ Trilogy! You also get a steam key for Adventure Field™ 4 if you don't want to unseal the game! So you can get the physical version of the 4 games + a steam key of the 4th game for $34,99 USD ( 43,93$ CAD ) + shipping fees!

The game come in a clear case with a custom double sided artwork so you can see the game map inside of the case!

notes.title: New UPDATE 1.1.1
notes.content:
This update feature : 

New Features...
[olist]
Shop & Merchant Level
Shop and merchant now have a star level system, the more you trade with them the more there level raise ( max 3 stars )...

Item Skill's
Bombs and Swamp Poison can now be used in battle via the skill's menu... ( Using the skill use 1 item from the inventory )...

The Gamble Skill
The Gamble skill provoke a random good or bad effect in battle...

The Tradeoff Skill
The Tradeoff skill let you trade golds for damage in battle...
[/olist]

Changes & Fixes
[olist]
Boss health/stats rebalancement
Boss stats has been boosted as they were too easy...

New colours in texts
Every time the words Souls Gems appear in texts they appear blue... 
Every time the words Legendary Sword appear in texts they appear orange...

Other changes & fixes
[olist]
Inn maps now point where you are on the map...
2 New NPC...
New NPC dialogues...
New Object : Swamp Poison, Gambling Scroll, Tradeoff Scroll...
New Skill's : Bomb, Swamp Poison, Gamble & Tradeoff...
Bugs & fixes...
Cut scene correction...
Text changes and correction...
Minor Bug fixes...
Other small tweaks...
Stability enhancement...
[/olist]
[/olist]We really hope that these changes and addition will help you enjoy the game even more!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 > 1.0.5
notes.content:
There have been 5 updates for the game since its official release. They have been silently pushed to drastically improve the game. Here the complete log of what changed :

-New Animations. ( Opening doors, Opening chests, Taking items, Looking at maps, etc... )
-Improved Day and Night System. ( NPC in & out time, lights & windows, overworld, dialogues )
-New HUD. ( Characters Slv, HP & MP, In-Combat HUD, Game Over )
-Shop & Inn NPC now have there shop name over there heads. 
-More Objects & Life. ( Cats, Dogs, Butterfly, Rabbit, Foods, Props & Furnitures )
-Map Shortcut on Keyboard & Controller. ( "Y controller" or "B keyboard" )
-Double Battle & Tutorial. ( Green souls on overworld )
-New In-game Events Gifts. ( Easter, Halloween & Christmas )
-Weather System. ( Rain & storms, new dialogue when it rain or storm outside )
-New Collectable Cards. ( Card pack & Premium card pack, deck of card, 55 collectable cards )
-New Quests. ( The Auction, The Fight Club, The Cat in the Chest, The Gourmet Way, Trade Away, Finding Barkley, The Well Phantoms, The Moon Chests and more... )
-Rabbit & Golden Rabbit on the Overworld. ( Rabbit Meat & Golden Rabbit Meat )
-The Cook Book. ( See recipes & Missing ingredients when cooking )
-New Items. ( Master Key, Parachnid Detector, Cook Book, Elixir, Moon Map, Phantoms Map, Combat Scroll & HP Trading Scroll )
-New Weapons. ( Sentinel Sword, Moon Sword & Combat Glove )
-New Armors. ( Moon Helmet, Black Magic for Dumbs, King's Crown, Cat Claws, Golden Mandragora, Santa Hat, Pumpkin Head & Bunny Ears )
-New Skills. ( Power Boost +, Blink Body +, MP Transfer, HP Trade, Close Combat & Dragon Rage )
-The Lottery Stand & Well Wishing.
-Further improvements to overall game stability and other minor adjustments have been made to enhance the user experience. ( Improved FPS in some areas, Grammar correction here and there, Bug fixing, Audio Fixing, etc... )

We really hope that these changes will help you enjoy the game even more!
